contests.title: Central DeWitt Community School District — Measure FC: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Clinton County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Central DeWitt Community School District in the County of Clinton, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $33,700,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the main campus building, including a secure entrance, high school academic wing, and site improvements; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the main campus building to serve all students, including educational and administrative spaces, and HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and accessibility improvements, including parking and site improvements?

measures.questionText: Shall the Board of Directors of the Central DeWitt Community School District in the County of Clinton, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $33,700,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the main campus building, including a secure entrance, high school academic wing, and site improvements; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the main campus building to serve all students, including educational and administrative spaces, and HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and accessibility improvements, including parking and site improvements?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $33.7 million in general-obligation bonds for a main-campus addition with a secure entrance and high school academic wing, renovations to educational and administrative spaces, heating and cooling, plumbing, roofing and accessibility improvements, equipment, parking and site improvements.
